concepts.name: coach
concepts.definition: A member of Easton staff with an eastontc.com Google account who signs in to the server through claude.ai.

concepts.name: tool
concepts.definition: An MCP tool an adapter registers: a title, a scope, the annotations, an input schema and a handler, served through the registry.

concepts.name: resource
concepts.definition: An MCP resource an adapter registers under a uri, with a scope the registry checks before every read.

concepts.name: role
concepts.definition: The coach or admin standing the role resolver assigns at login and at every refresh, carried in the access token.

concepts.name: adapter
concepts.definition: One folder per product that exports one Adapter: its tools, resources and prompts, mounted through the registry.

concepts.name: registry
concepts.definition: The MCP handler that mounts every adapter, checks the bearer scopes, caps results and writes one audit row per call. In the docs adapter, the documents table of root rows.

concepts.name: idempotency key
concepts.definition: A client supplied key a write tool must carry; the registry replays the stored result when the key repeats.

concepts.name: audit row
concepts.definition: The audit_log row the registry writes for every tool call and resource read, with the outcome and, for a write, the input and result.

concepts.name: leaderboard
concepts.definition: The easton-leaderboard product and its Supabase project, read by the leaderboard adapter through the publishable key.

concepts.name: drive
concepts.definition: Google Drive, reached by the docs adapter as the signed in coach through the service account.

concepts.name: collection
concepts.definition: A registered root row in the documents table, named by its title, that docs_search can filter on and docs_list answers.

concepts.name: google group
concepts.definition: A group in the eastontc.com Google Workspace directory. A row in scope_grants maps one group email to one scope, and the server reads a coach's direct groups at sign in and refresh.

concepts.name: google workspace
concepts.definition: The eastontc.com Google Workspace tenant that owns the accounts, the groups and the shared drives the server reads through the service account.
